normalized_facts: Under normal live-stream use, database-dependent player API requests periodically timed out or returned 504 while a version endpoint that did not require the database remained healthy.
The report traced the failure to a PostgreSQL connection checked out from a bounded per-worker pool and not returned on the live-stream teardown or channel-switch path.
After enough leaked connections accumulated, the eight-connection worker pool remained pinned at capacity even after all streams ended, and database-dependent requests stayed blocked until restart.
The report supplied a deterministic concurrent-stream reproduction plus a negative control in which short database reads recycled connections and did not reproduce the wedge.
The issue was automatically closed because it was not opened from the required repository template; the closure comment did not dispute the technical diagnosis.
provenance_limitations: This file is an EvalForge normalized semantic snapshot, not byte-for-byte GitHub issue content.
It is sufficient for candidate review provenance but not for research admission under the Phase 03 original-source preservation gate.
source_title: [Bug]: player_api.php / XC API hangs (504) under streaming load — PostgreSQL gevent-pool connection leak on live-stream teardown drains the per-worker pool
